items.title: Camouflage
must: The Hero is mostly hidden; the cover dominates
avoid: No lettering, numbers, dice, game tokens, or rulebook pages.
No full figure.
Not the Scout background or the Ranger class figure.
No enemies.

items.title: Wild Shape: the stag
must: An ordinary stag in build, not monstrous
avoid: No lettering, numbers, dice, game tokens, or rulebook pages.
No half-human transformation.
Not the Antlered Warden of the Tithe or any Monster.
No glow.

items.title: The bind
must: Hands and blades only; no faces
avoid: No lettering, numbers, dice, game tokens, or rulebook pages.
No full figures.
No glow or motion blur.
No gore.

items.title: The drowned bell tower
must: Only one coil of the wyrm is visible; no head, wings or full body
avoid: No lettering, numbers, dice, game tokens, or rulebook pages.
No full dragon and no breath.
Not the Black Dragon or Vossegar portraits, and not the Serpent's Sunken Hoard sinkhole.
No figures.

items.title: The Antlered Path cairn
must: Exactly three stones; no figures
avoid: No lettering, numbers, dice, game tokens, or rulebook pages.
Not the Whispering Grove standing stones.
No carved symbols or runes.
No glow.

items.title: The shield shove
must: The Dwarf is pushing, not striking; the Orc is falling back
avoid: No lettering, numbers, dice, game tokens, or rulebook pages.
Not the chapter 5 bridge clash and no undead.
Do not give the Dwarf a greataxe or a horned helm.
No gore.

items.title: Whiteout
must: The storm is drawn in line only; the white is the paper
avoid: No lettering, numbers, dice, game tokens, or rulebook pages.
No grey wash or tonal fog.
Not the Pale City climate gate.
No Monsters.

items.title: Rivals at the chest
must: Exactly two rival figures and one chest; the Monster shows only as one clawed arm and shoulder
avoid: No lettering, numbers, dice, game tokens, or rulebook pages.
Do not repeat the chapter 2 sighting across a fog valley or the cover's shrine arch.
No full Monster figure, face or portrait.
No banners or heraldic devices.
No gore.

items.title: Steadfast Word
must: Exactly two figures; the Paladin is lifting, not striking
avoid: No lettering, numbers, dice, game tokens, or rulebook pages.
No halo, sunburst or radiant glow.
Not the Tier 1 lantern-healing priest or the Tier 2 roadside shrine.
No longsword drawn and no enemy in frame.

items.title: Vine Lash
must: The vine visibly links Druid and Bandit
avoid: No lettering, numbers, dice, game tokens, or rulebook pages.
No metal weapon, armour or shield on the Druid.
Not the Tier 1 kneeling root ritual or the Tier 2 bending trees.
No gore.

items.title: Telekinetic Hand
must: The latch moves with no hand touching it
avoid: No lettering, numbers, dice, game tokens, or rulebook pages.
No glow beams or lightning.
Not the Tier 1 hovering-pebble meditation.
No treasure chest or trap.

items.title: Blood Flicker
must: One Sorcerer only, drawn once (not as a double image)
avoid: No lettering, numbers, dice, game tokens, or rulebook pages.
No metal Chest armour on the Sorcerer.
No glow, motion blur or ghost image.
Not the Tier 1 cut-palm close-up or the Tier 2 storm between the hands.
No gore.

items.title: Hook, rope, and spikes
must: Only these items
avoid: No lettering, numbers, dice, game tokens, or rulebook pages.
No lantern.
Not the background still lifes.
No labels.

items.title: Brigandine on the stand
must: One stand, no wearer
avoid: No lettering, numbers, dice, game tokens, or rulebook pages.
Not the Armoury room.
No full plate or knight's helm.
No heraldic devices.

items.title: Three starting bundles
must: Exactly three bundles
avoid: No lettering, numbers, dice, game tokens, or rulebook pages.
Not the chapter 6 hiring hall interior.
No labels or tags.
No figures.

items.title: The pierced breastplate
must: No wearer and no body
avoid: No lettering, numbers, dice, game tokens, or rulebook pages.
No blood or gore.
Not the Armoury room racks or the armour still life.
No maker's marks.

items.title: The full pack
must: One pack only
avoid: No lettering, numbers, dice, game tokens, or rulebook pages.
No weapons in the arrangement.
Not the background still lifes.
No labels.

items.title: The broker's scale
must: The single ring outweighs the coins
avoid: No lettering, numbers, dice, game tokens, or rulebook pages.
Not the Treasure Tables still life.
No sparkle effects.
No readable marks.

items.title: The Bell's Tongue
must: Only the clapper and the charm
avoid: No lettering, numbers, dice, game tokens, or rulebook pages.
No ringing lines or sound effects.
Not the Voice Beneath the Bells boss.
No runes.

items.title: Staff, sword, and symbol
must: Only these three objects
avoid: No lettering, numbers, dice, game tokens, or rulebook pages.
Not the Magic in the Dying Lands altar still life.
No runes or glyphs.
No glow.

items.title: Lesser missiles
must: Only the four named weapons; no bows
avoid: No lettering, numbers, dice, game tokens, or rulebook pages.
Not the Melee Weapons still life.
No shortbow, longbow or greatbow.
No maker's marks.

items.title: The contract and the map
must: No legible writing, numbers or symbols on map or contract
avoid: No lettering, numbers, dice, game tokens, or rulebook pages.
No compass rose or grid on the map.
Not the War Room interior.
No figures.

items.title: The spent scroll
must: No legible writing anywhere
avoid: No lettering, numbers, dice, game tokens, or rulebook pages.
No runes or glyphs.
No glow.
Not the Tier 2 Arcane copying scene.
